items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Benny Goodman's band organization, Jimmy Mundy writing for him, and the Savoy Ballroom battle, but does not state a personal or professional connection between himself and Goodman.

ctx.x: So Ella recorded with Benny Goodman when, about '35?
We already -- '35 to '36 anyhow, yeah, around there, because Benny Goodman's band organized around '35, in '35, because --
Yeah, '34, I think. Their big thing was that radio show.
